description: A USE STANDARD EXCEPTION/ERROR statement (Format 1, the file-exception declarative) without the word AFTER - a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction. The ANSI X3.23-1985 format underlines AFTER (USE AFTER STANDARD {EXCEPTION | ERROR} PROCEDURE ON ..., §1985:VII.4.6.2, printed page VII-50, and the same in every I-O module and the Inter-Program Communication module), so it is a required word at 85; the post-ballot ISO/IEC 1989:2002 text (2001-12-04, 14.8.45.1 Format 1) prints AFTER without underlining, as the 2023 text does (§2023:14.9.49.2). The 2002 Annex F.2 list names the PROCEDURE relaxation (item 141, use-without-procedure-2002) but not this one; the edge is read from the two printed formats, not from F.2 (kb/Work PB4919). Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitUseStatement, the Format 1 arm beside its PROCEDURE twin; Formats 3 and 4, whose AFTER is also optional, are 2002 introductions gated whole.
display: a USE STANDARD EXCEPTION/ERROR statement without the word AFTER
